rules.atr_exits: DDDDD LONG; TP distance 2*Wilder ATR14, SL distance 1*ATR14; ATR on latest completed 5m signal bar and frozen at entry
rules.relative_btc: DDDDD LONG TP1% SL1%, only if synchronous coin simple 60m return minus BTC simple 60m return >0
rules.failed_short: After DDDDD, first 1m close above preceding 1m high within 5m, then first close below original 5-bar pattern low within next 10m; SHORT next minute open TP1% SL1%

method: Fixed definitions committed before running; no parameter grid or symbol selection.
Same prior 10-symbol universe; BTC data only for relative-strength reference.
Minute candles, next-open entries, conservative simultaneous-barrier SL, adverse opening stop gaps.
Independent train/validation starts; no time stop, open positions at period boundaries recorded separately.
0.10% fees, 0.04% slippage, 0.02% funding reserve; reserve is not actual funding.
Constant independent notional trades; no portfolio, leverage, compounding or liquidation simulation.
Validation year already inspected; not a fresh untouched holdout.
New simulator baseline trade paths exactly reproduced prior simulator, checked for each symbol/period during the run.
Eligibility requires PF >1.15 and >=300 trades in EACH train and validation.
conclusion: No tested hypothesis passes; all aggregate variants lose net in both periods. Relative strength improves average expectancy but remains negative even at 0.10% assumed total cost.
